mode.title: Guard mode
mode.description: auto masks sensitive data automatically; confirm asks before sending; block stops sends containing sensitive data; monitor only records.

enabledEntities.title: Enabled entity types
enabledEntities.description: Entity types that are detected and masked.

neverRestore.title: Never-restore entity types
neverRestore.description: Entity types that are masked but never restored in responses.

literals.title: Literal terms
literals.description: Organisation-specific terms to mask (at most 1024; each 2..256 characters).

exactData.title: Exact data match datasets
exactData.description: HMAC-SHA256 fingerprint datasets built by fingerprint-dataset.mjs (at most 16 datasets and 100000 fingerprints in total). No key is carried here: each dataset key is derived by the AIDR Privacy native host from the secret in its configuration.

signalAction.title: Signal action
signalAction.description: off ignores signals, warn shows coaching, block stops the send.

blockedSites.title: Blocked sites
blockedSites.description: AI chat sites whose pages are blocked from loading.

disabledSites.title: Disabled sites
disabledSites.description: Sites where the guard only monitors: prompts, pastes and files are scanned and counted (reported as 'allowed' with entity counts) but nothing is masked, held back for confirmation or blocked by the guard. Organisation blocks (blockedSites, fileHandling 'block') still apply.

customSites.title: Custom internal AI sites
customSites.description: Company-internal AI chat portals where Browser Guard also masks prompts (at most 20). Hosts are exact HTTPS hostnames (no port, path or wildcard). Each user grants the extension access to these hosts once on the options page; the content script is then registered for them. Selectors are CSS selectors for the prompt editor, the send button and the assistant responses; generic fallbacks are always added.

shadowAi.title: Shadow AI discovery and control
shadowAi.description: mode: off (default), monitor (count visits to catalogued AI services per day; counts only, no URLs) or block-unsanctioned (also block every catalogued service not listed in sanctioned). Service ids in blocked are blocked in every mode. Ids are the Browser Guard catalog ids (for example chatgpt, gemini, poe, midjourney). Visibility and blocking need host access to the catalogued services, which each user grants once on the options page.

allowUserPause.title: Allow user pause
allowUserPause.description: Allow users to pause protection for up to 60 minutes.

allowSendAnyway.title: Allow send anyway
allowSendAnyway.description: Allow users to send a prompt unmasked after a warning.

maskPaste.title: Mask pasted text
maskPaste.description: Mask sensitive data as it is pasted.

fileHandling.title: File handling
fileHandling.description: scan sanitises uploaded files, block rejects them, allow passes them through.

documentHandling.title: Document handling
documentHandling.description: Office (DOCX/XLSX/PPTX), OpenDocument (ODT/ODS/ODP/ODG), legacy Office (DOC/XLS/PPT) and PDF uploads when fileHandling is scan. mask (default) masks Office and OpenDocument text in place and scans PDFs, blocking PDFs that contain sensitive data; legacy Office files cannot be parsed and are uploaded with an unscanned warning (blocked in block mode); block rejects every document upload, legacy formats included; allow skips document parsing and treats them like other binary files (uploaded with an unscanned warning, blocked in block mode). Macro-enabled, encrypted or externally linked documents are always blocked under mask.

maxFileBytes.title: Maximum file size
maxFileBytes.description: Largest file (bytes) that is scanned; at most 52428800 (50 MiB).

restoreResponses.title: Restore responses
restoreResponses.description: Restore original values in responses locally.

useNativeHost.title: Use native host
useNativeHost.description: Use the locally installed AIDR Privacy native host for NER (PERSON, ADDRESS, LOCATION in free text) on prompts and pastes, merged with the built-in rules. Also needs the optional 'nativeMessaging' permission, which the user grants on the options page; without it (or without the host) scans run rules-only and the user is told so.

requireNativeNer.title: Require native NER
requireNativeNer.description: Make native NER mandatory (default false). When true and PERSON, ADDRESS or LOCATION is enabled, a prompt, paste or file upload whose text the native host could not check with NER (host not installed or not permitted, crashed, timed out, rules-only host without an approved NER model, malformed reply, text over the host limit) is blocked with an explanation instead of continuing rules-only; images the host could not OCR are blocked too. Monitor mode never blocks but records such checks as not NER-checked (telemetry native_ner: unavailable). Forces and locks useNativeHost on. The signed dashboard policy (dashboardPolicy) can also switch it on; true from either side wins.

telemetry.title: Control-plane telemetry
telemetry.description: Privacy telemetry enrollment (counts only). controlPlaneUrl must be https (http only for localhost/127.0.0.1).

acceptableUse.title: AI acceptable-use notice
acceptableUse.description: Notice shown once per version on the first visit to a protected AI site, with an 'I understand' acknowledgement. Raise version to show it again. Only the id and version of each acknowledgement are reported (counts only); the text never leaves the browser.

text.description: Plain text, 1 to 4000 characters; blank lines separate paragraphs.

url.description: Optional https link to the full policy (at most 2048 characters).

dashboardPolicy.title: Apply Shadow AI decisions from the AIDR dashboard
dashboardPolicy.description: Ed25519 public keys (SPKI PEM, the connectors' policy_public_keys_pem) that sign the control plane's Browser Guard policy, and optionally the tenant id it must be issued for. With this key and telemetry set, the extension fetches the signed document on startup, on every managed-policy change and every 15 minutes, and applies the dashboard's allow/block decisions for AI services. An unsigned or tampered document is ignored. The dashboard can only tighten shadowAi: its blocks always apply, its allows never unblock a service this managed policy blocks (most restrictive wins).

allowUserOverrides.title: Allow user overrides of protection settings
allowUserOverrides.description: When any managed policy is present, the user can no longer change mode, enabled entity types, custom literals, paste masking, response restore or per-site disabling (they stay at the managed or built-in value). Set to true to let users keep changing the ones this policy does not set.
